scripts.format: prettier --write README.MD package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml docker-compose.yml .env.example .github apps packages tests playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.MD package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml docker-compose.yml .env.example .github apps packages tests playwright.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/backend alembic -c apps/backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:downgrade: uv run --project apps/backend alembic -c apps/backend/alembic.ini downgrade -1
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project apps/backend uvicorn api.main:app --app-dir apps/backend/src --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project apps/backend ruff check apps/backend/src apps/backend/tests
scripts.typecheck:backend: uv run --project apps/backend pyright apps/backend/src apps/backend/tests
scripts.check:stage0: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:frontend && pnpm typecheck:frontend && pnpm test:frontend && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm lint:backend && pnpm typecheck:backend && pnpm test:backend && pnpm exec playwright test --list
scripts.check:stage2: pnpm check:stage1 && pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/stage0.spec.ts tests/e2e/stage2-public-map.spec.ts
scripts.check:stage3: pnpm check:stage2 && pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/stage3-map-search-filters.spec.ts
